verified.rebuild: 2026-10-20 ("I just tried to start an amazon music station but nothing happened"): Amazon replaced its web player some time after 2026-10-05. Every selector of 0.1.x (music-vertical-item, music-button, #transport, nav#music-navbar, music-shoveler, #navbarSearchInput) matched nothing; the station press searched three pages for a card that no longer exists and stopped. Everything below was read live on the new player on 2026-10-20 unless marked unverified.
verified.selectors.transport: the mini player bar at the foot: [data-testid='Slider,MiniPlayer_ProgressSlider'] holds a [role=slider] with aria-valuenow / aria-valuemax in seconds
verified.controls: the mini player buttons: [data-testid='IconButton,MiniPlayer_Pause'] while playing, [data-testid='IconButton,MiniPlayer_Play'] while paused (one replaces the other), MiniPlayer_NextButton, MiniPlayer_PreviousButton; the Like (MiniPlayer_Follow_Follow), the queue (MiniPlayer_PlayQueueButton) and Volume are left alone
verified.musicContext: the bar: the [role=slider] is an ANCESTOR of [data-testid='Slider,MiniPlayer_ProgressSlider'] (closest, not querySelector) with aria-valuenow / aria-valuemax in seconds; a[data-testid=MiniPlayer_Title][href=/tracks/<ASIN>] (the track, trackId from the href), the first a[href^=/artists/] (the artist), then a plain div[aria-label=<collection name>] after a ' - ' (the station or playlist playing: 'Today's Hits'). The page carries no collection id anywhere in its DOM (every card is a div[role=link][aria-label='Play <name>'] / 'Pause <name>' while it plays), so id = <kind>:<slug of the name>. kind: the row header above the card that shows 'Pause <name>' (Stations for You / Top Stations / Recently Played ... -> station, Playlists -> playlist), remembered per name while the page lives; off such a page, the route, else station.
verified.musicPlay: (kind, id, name): finds the card div[role=link][aria-label='Play <name>'] by the name's slug (a 'Pause <name>' card is already playing) and presses its inner button; a card not on this page: the home page, then /stations (or /my/playlists/by-me for a playlist), then /search/<name> whose Stations / Playlists rows list it (All Hits Radio seen in Stations of its search), carried across the loads in sessionStorage. The old /stations/<ASIN> address now opens 'Problem finding content'. Core sends the name as the third argument (2026-10-20); an old id alone ('station:all-hits-radio') is read as the name.
verified.musicLibrary: /my/playlists redirects to /my/playlists/by-me: the person's own playlists as a[role=link][href=/user-playlists/<uuid>] with the name as text (Cross Service, My Likes); a second link per tile is aria-labelled 'Navigate to <name>' and skipped. The Followed pill ([data-testid='Button,ButtonNavigator_Button,LibraryPlaylistPills_FollowedPill_Unselected']) is not pressed: followed playlists are not listed yet.
verified.musicLookup: the search box is input[data-testid=SearchBox_TextInput] on /search (the top bar's magnifier is a[href=/search], pressed first when the box is absent); Enter routes the SPA to /search/<term>. Songs: the row under the 'Songs' header ([data-testid=WidgetHeader_Primary_SearchResults_ResultsHeader]) of [data-testid='HorizontalItem,SearchResultsWidget_Item'] each with a[href=/tracks/<ASIN>?do=play] (the title), a[href^=/artists/], an img and [data-testid='IconButton,SearchResultsWidget_Item_OverflowMenu']. The row menu is [role=menuitem] rows: Add to Playlist, Share, View Album, View Artist, Report, Play Similar Music. Add to Playlist opens [data-testid=AddToPlaylistModal] with [data-testid^=AddToPlaylist_Item_] rows ([data-testid=PlaylistItem_Title] carries the name; the modal's header says Recents, so a playlist never added to may be missing), Close ([data-testid='Button,AddToPlaylist_CancelButton']) and Create Playlist. The add's confirmation toast ([data-testid=toastContentContainer]) is unverified: no add was made on the household's account. Play Similar Music starts a station from the song (unverified live).
verified.js.ad-signals: 2026-10-20, read from one break in host.log, the page itself unseen during it ("was playing an ad that was not muted"): a track plays from a blob: source (MSE, Widevine), while the ad at 10:04:33 played for 60 seconds from a plain https://m.media-amazon.com/images/S/al-na-... source in its own media element, and the bar named the advertiser (Fidelity) as the title. The signal is that element: a playing audio or video whose source is under https://m.media-amazon.com/images/ is an ad, with its remaining time from the element. Verified live 2026-10-20 12:40:50: the next break raised ad-break, core muted the page and showed the intermission, ad-info counted it down, and the person confirmed it ("next amazon ad was covered and muted"). The bar's own ad markers are still unread.

session.verified: 2026-10-20, the player rebuilt by Amazon (Expo / React Native Web, data-testid everywhere, not one music-* element left): signedIn = the settings button (Go to settings, button#settingsButton) in the top bar of the signed-in player, and the Like button of the mini player while a track plays; read live. signedOut: unverified - no signed-out page seen since the rebuild; a sign-in link or button is the guess.

notes: §32 music adapter slice. 0.2.0 (2026-10-20): the whole adapter rewritten for Amazon's rebuilt web player (see verified.rebuild). Transport is forwarded only on a human press (core pass-through), never on a timer; a missing control falls through to the service's own Media Session handlers. Scripts stay free of double quotes and backslashes (they live in JSON). Previously: §32 music adapter slice (2026-09-09, first cut): transport is forwarded only on a human press (core pass-through), never on a timer; a missing control falls through to the service's own Media Session handlers. No ad-break signal yet, so no audio intermission on this source until the markers are verified on a signed-in free-tier run. Added on request as a fourth music source beside Apple Music, Spotify and Pandora. Cross-service lookup (2026-09-17, B-218): the page route like Pandora's and Spotify's - the player's own search box and the song row's own menu; Add to Playlist by the playlist's name in the picker; the station from a song is the song's own mix page (the row's title link opens it and starts it; the page's Shuffle is the fallback). English only for now: the menu items are matched by their English labels.
